final: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) as avg_line_cost, AVG(CASE WHEN product_price IS NOT NULL AND product_price != 0 THEN derived_total_cost / product_price ELSE NULL END) as invoice_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall_avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) as overall_avg FROM invoice_stats WHERE invoice_ratio IS NOT NULL), kept_invoices AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, i.avg_line_cost, i.invoice_ratio FROM invoice_stats i, overall_avg_ratio o WHERE i.invoice_ratio IS NOT NULL AND i.invoice_ratio > o.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_line_cost) as avg_of_avg_line_costs, AVG(invoice_ratio) as avg_of_invoice_ratios, AVG(invoice_ratio) - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg_ratio) as ratio_excess_over_average FROM kept_invoices
